hero.lead_es: MPA Flow es una consultora de arquitectura de sistemas y transformación organizacional. Diseñamos y lideramos transformaciones conectando procesos, talento, tecnología e IA aplicada: desde la observación del sistema hasta el diseño, implementación, adopción y evolución de nuevas formas de operar.
hero.lead_en: MPA Flow is a systems architecture and organizational transformation consultancy. We design and lead transformations by connecting processes, talent, technology, and applied AI—from observing the system through designing, implementing, adopting, and evolving new ways of operating.

projects.name: JRInvestor
projects.category_es: Producto digital · Inteligencia patrimonial con IA
projects.description_es: Plataforma que consolida posiciones de Wall Street y Argentina y articula agentes especializados para convertir información financiera en análisis claros y accionables.
projects.description_en: A platform that consolidates Wall Street and Argentine positions and coordinates specialized agents to turn financial information into clear, actionable analysis.
projects.image_alt: JRInvestor — plataforma de inteligencia patrimonial con agentes de IA
projects.challenge_es: Unificar activos distribuidos entre mercados, monedas y brokers sin perder contexto para la decisión.
projects.challenge_en: Unify assets distributed across markets, currencies, and brokers without losing decision context.
projects.architecture_es: Portfolios consolidados, integración de datos y un sistema de agentes especializados para análisis, alertas e informes.
projects.architecture_en: Consolidated portfolios, data integration, and specialized agents for analysis, alerts, and reporting.
projects.outcome_es: Una lectura patrimonial centralizada, comprensible y orientada a decisiones accionables.
projects.outcome_en: A centralized, understandable wealth view designed for actionable decisions.

contact.title_en: What are you looking to make possible?

contact.lead_en: Tell us a little about your idea, need, or challenge. You don't need to know yet what kind of solution you need. We can start with the question.
